headline: Sainz must start the Singapore sprint from the pit lane
body: Williams changed Sainz's suspension setup under parc fermé without the technical delegate's approval. The stewards require him to start the sprint from the pit lane.

headline: Red Bull replaces Hadjar's engine before the Singapore sprint
body: Red Bull fitted Hadjar's car with a previously used engine and turbo, replaced the fuel collector assembly and adjusted the related power-unit parameters before the sprint. The changes were approved by the FIA technical delegate.

headline: Heavy rain delays the Singapore sprint
body: Heavy rain delayed the sprint's scheduled 17:00 local start at Marina Bay. Marshals are clearing standing water from the circuit as the rain begins to ease.
